mechanism: Polyethylene glycol (PEG) electrolyte solutions containing magnesium sulfate may increase systemic magnesium absorption and the osmotic laxative effect of PEG is enhanced by magnesium, potentially leading to excessive fluid loss and electrolyte depletion.
action: Monitor serum magnesium levels and hydration status when PEG electrolyte solutions containing magnesium are used; avoid additional magnesium supplementation during bowel preparation with magnesium-containing PEG solutions.
